pecas.prompt: A friendly cartoon cow standing on four legs, with a creamy white body covered in a few big black patches, a soft pink muzzle, two small horns, floppy ears and a gentle smile, seen from the side. Soft matte clay 3D illustration, children's storybook style, rich saturated colours, soft shadows. The whole object is inside the frame, centred, seen from a slight three-quarter angle, filling about three quarters of the image height. Soft even studio light coming from the upper left, gentle contact shadow directly under the object. The animal floats alone on a plain, perfectly flat, bright magenta background (#FF00FF), with clear empty margin on all four sides. Every surface is smooth, blank and unmarked. The image contains only the object itself. Modelled in soft matte clay, like a children's storybook toy.
